# LexFlow — Legal SaaS for modern law firms

> LexFlow unifies case management, document intelligence, billing, and client communication in one calm, role-aware workspace built for law firms. Designed for firms of 5-20 people. Bilingual EN/IT/RU. Dark/light themes.

## Key facts
- Product: AI-native legal practice management (case management, document intelligence, client intake, billing)
- Compliance: GDPR, ISO 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27701:2025
- Client model: no client login/install — token-secured private link
- Team roles: Senior Partner, Associate, Paralegal, Intern
- Live pilot: Studio Legale X, Genoa, Italy
